digest.component_or_area: ticket store and optimistic concurrency control
propositions: A verified ticket description write succeeded and read-back correct, then a subsequent read returned an older revision without error or conflict detection
Optimistic concurrency protection (ConcurrencyError on conflicting write) did not fire; the write reported success but was silently rolled back afterwards
An unconditional whole-field description EDIT with older client-held text can clobber newer events through last-writer-wins reduction when concurrent writes occur during in-flight review operations
Read-back verification is insufficient to detect silent rollback, invalidating the standard agent mitigation of verify-after-write

The reducer cache race (fixed in commit 0b964c82f5) allowed older reducer generations to publish stale state, but stale whole-body writes remain possible through valid events with outdated client data
